posts.meta_description: 671 likes, 36 comments - namitathapar on October 26, 2026: "The consumer company I run has 2 brands, Arth & Galact. What I want to point out is that Galact is the ONLY lactation brand that has invested in a GOLD standard clinical trial with over 100 patients, something that takes enormous amount of money & time !! In India as well as abroad, most supplement companies selling direct to consumer like me, still don’t invest in trials. So I’m really proud we did this large & super expensive clinical trial. We will continue investing in “evidence based” approach to build trust & respect in what we sell 💪💪".

5,311 likes, 109 comments - namitathapar on October 17, 2026: "I had made this reel 6 months back & then forgot to post it ! Today, Oct 18 is world menopause day & so I dug it up to remind myself & others that just like we celebrate bridal showers, baby showers… let’s start menopause parties, let’s celebrate a beautiful new chapter in a woman’s life. Life’s tougher due to the extra weight & health challenges but easier due to the new attitude & thicker skin we develop :) 
Happy World Menopause Day. Get educated, be kinder to urself & support other women !".

posts.meta_description:
5,766 likes, 25 comments - namitathapar on October 14, 2026: "Enjoyed meeting Harsh & Tanvi from Bear House @bearhouseindia (Season 4) & Arun from Janitri @janitri_for_hospitals (Season 2). Sharing some updates on my dear founders from @sharktank.india 

A 450 CR ARR powerhouse, Bear House makes me proud. I wear their flannel shirts a lot as I love the class & comfort. With 15000 sku, 32 EBO, 500 plus offline presence… offline went from 0% to 50% of sales in one year. They are expanding into footwear, fragrances & bags. Loving their new campaign that uses only one glass of water in each denim. 

Arun is doing such important work at Janitri. I’m so happy to state that this innovative healthcare company focusing on high risk pregnancy has now got 15 patents ! I’m loving their new launch, Navam Temp Live, smart fever patch for babies.".
